proof_scope: Real CLI render and independent XML readback, plus over-budget scene rejection. Not human visual approval or browser animation proof.

cases.name: neutral-panels-render-readback
command: cd .. && export ARTIFACT_DIR=$(mktemp -d /mnt/storage12tb/skills/create-svg/oai-proof-drafts/eval.XXXXXX) && ./run.sh render assets/templates/comparison-panels.yml "$ARTIFACT_DIR/panels.svg" && python3 -c 'import os,xml.etree.ElementTree as E; r=E.parse(os.environ["ARTIFACT_DIR"]+"/panels.svg").getroot(); ns={"s":"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"}; g=r.findall("s:g",ns); assert len(g)==2; assert [x.attrib["data-component"] for x in g]==["panel-0","panel-1"]; boxes=[x.find("s:rect",ns).attrib for x in g]; assert boxes[0]["width"]==boxes[1]["width"]; assert not r.findall(".//s:path",ns); assert len(r.findall(".//s:text",ns))==7; print("PANEL_READBACK_PASS")'

cases.name: over-budget-label-refused
command: cd .. && export ARTIFACT_DIR=$(mktemp -d /mnt/storage12tb/skills/create-svg/oai-proof-drafts/eval.XXXXXX) && python3 -c 'import os,yaml; from pathlib import Path; d=yaml.safe_load(Path("assets/templates/comparison-panels.yml").read_text()); d["columns"][0]["heading"]="this label has too many words"; Path(os.environ["ARTIFACT_DIR"]+"/bad.yml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump(d))' && ./run.sh render "$ARTIFACT_DIR/bad.yml" "$ARTIFACT_DIR/bad.svg"
